minimal_completion_criterion: One legal finite-length complex over complex Hilbert spaces with vanishing reduced records at every degree, for which the requested bounded contraction or a bounded linear right inverse of a layer L_j cannot exist, is sufficient.
The candidate need not prove the exact closed-range criterion after giving a complete counterexample.
